description: This file contains unit tests for the RemoveKeySession IPC functionality in the Rialto media key handling component. It defines a test fixture class and multiple test cases to verify success, failure, disconnection, reconnection, and error scenarios related to removing a key session via IPC.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcRemoveKeySessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the RemoveKeySession IPC functionality, derived from MediaKeysIpcTestBase. It sets up the IPC environment and provides helper methods to simulate responses.
